core_contribution.summary: Extend the existing supervisor, without creating another controller, so it loads this graph, validates it, reconciles durable state, claims the next eligible task, and evaluates mission completion.
Add validated task goal/contribution bindings and a durable lifecycle scoreboard so selection, transition, and closure remain tied to the presentable full-portfolio deliverable.
Add stable, deduplicated taskcards for every mandatory non-deprecated requirement and record verified completion without reopening valid evidence.
Preserve the valuable dirty candidate, establish the Level-8 Waves 0-8 sequence as the sole active program, and eliminate status and evidence overclaims after satisfying all edit gates.
Replace the contradictory active execution tracks with the approved Level-8 Waves 0-8 while preserving decision history and current evidence.
Investigate every finding, add exact existing evidence when genuine, downgrade unsupported claims when permitted, and drive the semantic matrix to zero high-confidence findings.
Inventory provenance and useful content, preserve it without legitimizing a conflicting plan, and record the exact gated migration/disposition.
Clone the current committed HEAD into runs, install only from the committed lock, and rerun all official checks without relying on the dirty source working tree.
Decompose the runtime seams, route compatibility commands through the same capability, authorization, effect-ledger, and verifier spine, and make every required failure fail closed.
Introduce versioned trigger, checkpoint, health, and manifest contracts and prove recovery at every lifecycle boundary under the Git-ref state backend.
Implement ProductFactsV2, precedence/conflict behavior, claim citations, surface ownership, protected-content fingerprints, isolated example execution, and prompt-injection treatment.
Complete the safe repository-local Wave 3 foundation while leaving hosted execution, production effects, and Wave 3 closure dependent on the blocked Wave 2 production proof.
Implement RepositoryPresentationPlanV1, AST/source-span README patches, archetype-specific intelligence, metadata/community/visual proposals, ownership constraints, and governed golden evaluation.
Complete the safe repository-local Wave 4 planning and patch foundation while leaving production proposals, model-route scoring, and full Wave 4 closure dependent on the blocked production chain.
Make direct local, complete current-workflow act, and isolated staging execution pass in that order against one canonical runtime before any production credential or production-pilot work resumes.
Finish deterministic finding, proposal, remaining-work, and stop classification and restore every official local check without weakening any safety boundary.
Make every fact, plan, render, and verifier consume one revision and populate enough verified truth to author the three Java pilot READMEs.
Coordinate the governed local-portfolio child tasks and close only from their aggregate evidence after every registry entry reaches Gate-A acceptance.
Add --registry and the fail-closed local_poc profile to supervise, loading every current products.json entry and persisting one durable per-repository lifecycle.
Add a typed stage limit to the existing supervise runtime so a registry run can stop honestly at FACTS_READY without invoking later phases.
Bind cached facts and later lifecycle state to required fields, eligibility, polarity, conflict, and render-view contract hashes.

Add one redacted append-only call ledger at the shared live/fixture client-provider seam and reconcile exact per-repository, revision, stage, job, attempt, token, latency, outcome, cache, and optional cost totals into run and portfolio manifests.
Reconcile every active prompt to one declared owner, job, runtime consumer, contract, and invalidation scope and block paid fan-out on orphan, duplicate, inline, stale, or unsafe prompt changes.
Classify product, test, sample, converter, generator, benchmark, build-tool, and unknown roots and select the distributed product root deterministically.
Freeze a source-to-local provenance, license, dependency, contract, and test matrix for the smallest compatible committed sibling behaviors before implementing the three platform adapters.
Adapt package-root, canonical-import, re-export, public-API, property, typed-field, and snippet extraction and prove selected symbols through an installed pinned package in an isolated consumer.
Adapt package-root, exports/declarations, public-API, visibility, snippet, format, and completeness behavior and compile an isolated consumer against the pinned packed or built artifact.
Adapt Cargo/lib identity, module/re-export, visibility, type/member/trait/implementation, rustdoc, snippet, and format extraction and verify a pinned isolated consumer example.
Require positive implementation evidence for capabilities and explicit constraint evidence for limitations.
Provide one disposable OS-isolated executor with bounded resources, filesystem, processes, time, and deny-by-default network.

Select a registry-verified coordinate when published and a reproducible source-build path otherwise, while executing repository or dependency build code only inside a disposable OS-isolated executor with bounded resources and deny-by-default network.
Prove imports or namespaces, public symbols, compilation or execution, and secret-free inputs for selected examples in the same disposable OS-isolated executor used for acquisition proof.
Ground audience and problem statements with citations and make typed render views the only prose-eligible fact interface.
Run the facts-only canonical supervisor for one real Java, .NET, Python, TypeScript, C++, Go, and Rust repository.
Run every current registry entry only through FACTS_READY and classify any essential external fact blocks exactly.
Produce provenance-complete ProductFactsV2 graphs plus typed visitor-facing render views and public-API-verified examples for every supported ecosystem.
Freeze public inputs, outputs, candidate bytes, plan hashes, and known failure fixtures before structural extraction.
Capture failing real and synthetic cases for partial limitations, examples, installation, and overview sections before implementation.
Capture advisory-decision, competing-example, stale-span, and reconstruction failures before tightening operation coverage.
Freeze real and synthetic raw-token, duplication, competing-example, identity, navigation, and ordering defects with expected spans.
Freeze immutable source revisions, fact bundles, and expected composition obligations for seven real representatives.
Split renderer and agentic-composition responsibilities behind unchanged public seams before adding editorial behavior.
Keep ownership and idempotency metadata in durable evidence while producing marker-free factual README headers, verified badges, and sanitized repository-specific Mermaid overview graphs.

Produce domain-pure verified article catalogs, select only reader-useful contextual links through configured-or-deterministic automatic slot allocation, and enforce Enterprise Edition as the sole visitor-facing aspose.com product edition name.

Inventory every material source content unit, preferentially reuse it after evidence or authoritative-owner validation, improve it only with verified clarity, correct contradictions, and withhold unresolved factual material without losing its traceability.
Inventory every material inherited and generated content unit and freeze its expected evidence, owner validation, reuse, improvement, uncertainty, correction, or omission disposition.

Reject any actionable assessment without a candidate-producing source-span operation, account for every material inherited and generated final-candidate claim through an accepted fact, authoritative owner, or explicit uncertainty/correction operation, and independently reconstruct the result.
Deterministically reject internal tokens, semantic duplicates, competing examples, cross-product leakage, malformed navigation, and promotional imbalance.
Run the stage-limited canonical supervisor through deterministic validation for one real representative per supported ecosystem.
Compile every actionable assessment into bounded ReadmeDocumentPlanV1 operations and generate the candidate solely by applying those operations to the immutable source.
Define independent blind visitor-quality and factual-plan inputs, prompts, identities, caches, and verdict combination.
Require candidate spans for content findings and exact fact/evidence references with valid polarity for factual findings.
Bind repair instructions to source operations and prove candidate delta plus finding resolution before rereview.
Reuse valid facts, composition, and review artifacts by complete input fingerprints while still proving no change.
Run good, defective, repairable, conflicting, and missing-evidence outputs across seven real representatives.
Define separate blind visitor-quality and fact-and-plan reviewer contracts with independent prompts, contexts, identities, and caches.
Require candidate spans for quality findings and exact fact or evidence references with checked polarity for factual findings.
Check candidate and operation deltas plus cited-finding resolution before spending another independent review call.
Reuse valid fact, authoring, validation, and review results on unchanged reruns without duplicate state or LLM work.
Accept strong and reject defective real candidate outputs across all seven supported ecosystems.
Enforce blind visitor-quality review plus independent factual/plan review, combine both fail-closed, and require every repair to materially change and resolve the responsible candidate spans.
Hash HEAD, registry, source revisions, dependencies, prompts, templates, facts, renderer, validators, reviewer, and lifecycle contracts.
Run the complete canonical pipeline twice for one real representative per ecosystem under the immutable campaign.
Add portfolio-wide writer exclusion and renew the mission claim through long clone, build, LLM, test, and cohort operations.
Run at least 100 evaluations in three independent sessions using synthetic and frozen real-output controls.
Mark the qualified campaign immutable and enforce representative requalification after any dependent contract change.
Bind control HEAD, registry, source revisions, dependencies, prompts, templates, fact contract, renderer, validators, reviewer, and lifecycle hashes.
Run first proposal and unchanged no-op for one real representative per supported ecosystem under one campaign.
Enforce a portfolio writer lease, renew mission claims, and recover cancellation without duplicate work or descendants.
Run at least 100 evaluations across three sessions with complete real-output controls and automatic route disablement.
Measure official checks and cold, warm, per-stage, clone, registry, LLM, and no-op runtime cost under the accepted representative campaign.
Make Gate-A preflight require the exact accepted campaign and reject execution after any dependent contract mutation.
Qualify the complete canonical pipeline on a frozen real-output campaign across all supported ecosystems before full-registry fan-out.
Process the runtime denominator in deterministic ecosystem/family cohorts under one campaign and portfolio writer lease.
Classify each non-success as truth, composition, review, recovery, or genuine external fact work and repair upstream.
Complete deterministic validation, independent review/repair, and an unchanged no-op rerun for every eligible entry.
Rebuild the denominator and every accepted result from registry, campaign, state, bundles, and checksum inventories.
Execute the frozen denominator in ecosystem or family cohorts with one writer lease and an incremental current-state summary.
Classify each failure at its first responsible boundary, repair it, requalify the affected representative, and rerun only invalidated repositories.
Reach independent approval and unchanged no-op proof for every eligible current registry entry under the identical frozen campaign.
Reconstruct the portfolio result and checksum inventory from the frozen registry and per-repository bundles without trusting the runtime summary.
Execute the canonical profile across every current registry entry until each has a checksum-valid agent-approved local bundle and unchanged rerun proof.
Present only agent-approved, no-op-proven local README bundles for human review and record a separate acceptance decision for every current registry entry.
Produce one-command local proof across README, metadata, community, visual handoff, package/release, generated signals, cross-surface validation, and recovery scenarios.
Run the same reusable workflow through every applicable job and trigger path with isolated local state and no production authentication fallback.
Create disposable staging targets and prove the production-equivalent proposal lifecycle without changing any target default branch.
After full Gate-A/B acceptance, separate verified proposal construction from terminal authorized effects and prove the PR lifecycle locally without provisioning or using GitHub App credentials.
Execute the full baseline, facts, plan, surfaces, verified draft PR, rerun, overwrite, interruption, duplicate, and isolated-failure matrix for 3D, Cells, and PDF Java.
After Gate C is independently accepted, provision and integrate the production GitHub App with separate read/effect tokens and no PAT fallback.
Prove observe/proposal mode for the full registry, then one authorized representative per Java, .NET, Python, TypeScript, C++, Go, and Rust, followed by 30 clean production days.

Operate the complete system for 90 consecutive days with weekly portfolio audits, automatic regression disablement, dependency and authorization monitoring, recovery, proposal freshness, dead-man monitoring, quality/traffic reporting, and independent audit.
